categories.title: Engagement in Learning
categories.hint: How the student takes part in learning.

natural-curiosity.label: Natural Curiosity
natural-curiosity.description: Shows interest in new ideas and asks questions that help deepen their understanding of the world around them.

willing-participation.label: Willing Participation
willing-participation.description: Contributes to learning activities and discussions, showing a willingness to become involved and share ideas.

persistent-effort.label: Persistent Effort
persistent-effort.description: Keeps working when tasks become challenging and shows determination to make progress.

regular-engagement.label: Regular Engagement
regular-engagement.description: Would benefit from participating more consistently in learning activities, using manageable tasks and agreed support to build momentum.

sustained-effort.label: Sustained Effort
sustained-effort.description: Could strengthen their learning by staying with tasks beyond the initial attempt and using support when the work becomes challenging.

getting-started.label: Getting Started
getting-started.description: Is working on beginning a task with a clear first step, so learning time is used from the start.

staying-focused.label: Staying Focused
staying-focused.description: Is working on staying with the learning for longer, using an agreed check-in when attention drifts.

respectful-communication.label: Respectful Communication
respectful-communication.description: Expresses ideas and responds to others in ways that support positive relationships and productive learning.

working-together.label: Working Together
working-together.description: Works cooperatively with others, shares responsibilities and contributes to a common goal.

attentive-listening.label: Attentive Listening
attentive-listening.description: Listens carefully to staff and classmates and uses what they hear to guide their work and contributions.

sharing-ideas.label: Sharing Ideas
sharing-ideas.description: Would benefit from contributing their thinking more often through a format that suits them, such as conversation, writing or a small-group discussion.

managing-frustration.label: Managing Frustration
managing-frustration.description: Would benefit from recognising early signs of frustration and practising agreed strategies before difficulties interrupt their learning.

building-confidence.label: Building Confidence
building-confidence.description: Could develop greater confidence by attempting manageable challenges and recognising progress, even when the result is not yet perfect.

turn-taking.label: Turn Taking
turn-taking.description: Is working on waiting for a turn in conversation so that everyone can be heard.

calm-words.label: Calm Words
calm-words.description: Is working on using calm, respectful words when something feels difficult.

categories.title: Attendance / Context
categories.hint: Factual context. State only what was selected.

consistent-attendance.label: Consistent Attendance
consistent-attendance.description: Attends regularly, helping them maintain learning routines, build relationships and develop their skills over time.

positive-reconnection.label: Positive Reconnection
positive-reconnection.description: Has made encouraging progress in returning to learning and reconnecting with staff, classmates and classroom routines.

attendance-routines.label: Attendance Routines
attendance-routines.description: Would benefit from working with staff and family or carers to address attendance barriers and establish a more consistent connection with school.

settling-in.label: Settling In
settling-in.description: Could make better use of learning time by following an agreed arrival routine and beginning with a clear, achievable first task.

returning-to-learning.label: Returning to Learning
returning-to-learning.description: Could maintain progress by following a supported plan for rejoining learning after a break, absence or difficult moment.

gaps-in-attendance.label: Gaps in Attendance
gaps-in-attendance.description: Some learning has been missed, and a steadier pattern of attendance is the focus so routines can take hold.

arriving-late.label: Arriving Late
arriving-late.description: Arriving after learning has started is being worked on, with an agreed way to join the lesson calmly.

personal-progress.label: Personal Progress
personal-progress.description: Has made meaningful progress towards individual learning goals, building skills and confidence from their own starting point.

using-feedback.label: Using Feedback
using-feedback.description: Uses comments, examples or a checklist to adjust the next piece of work and can point to what has improved.

setting-small-goals.label: Setting Small Goals
setting-small-goals.description: Would benefit from choosing a specific, achievable learning goal and regularly reviewing progress with staff.

checking-work.label: Checking Work
checking-work.description: Could improve the accuracy and clarity of their work by reviewing it against instructions, examples or a simple checklist.

following-through.label: Following Through
following-through.description: Could demonstrate more of their learning by completing agreed tasks and returning to unfinished work with staff support.

unfinished-tasks.label: Unfinished Tasks
unfinished-tasks.description: Some agreed tasks are still unfinished, and completing them with support is the current focus.

trying-when-unsure.label: Trying When Unsure
trying-when-unsure.description: Starting work when the answer is not yet clear is being practised, with permission to attempt a first step.

categories.title: Specific Adjustments / Supports
categories.hint: Adjustments already in place. Selected items, and anything typed below, are named in one sentence.

learning-support.label: Learning support
learning-support.description: Extra help with the learning is already part of lessons.

adjusted-tasks.label: Adjusted tasks
adjusted-tasks.description: Tasks are adjusted so the student can show what they know.

extra-time.label: Extra time
extra-time.description: More time is given to begin, work and finish.

assistive-technology.label: Assistive technology
assistive-technology.description: A tool or device is used so the student can take part in the learning.

visual-supports.label: Visual supports
visual-supports.description: A visual shows the steps or what the finished learning looks like.

structured-routines.label: Structured routines
structured-routines.description: A clear routine sets out what happens and in which order.

sensory-supports.label: Sensory supports
sensory-supports.description: The setting or materials are adjusted for sensory comfort.

wellbeing-support.label: Wellbeing support
wellbeing-support.description: Support for wellbeing is part of the regular routine.

family-communication.label: Family communication
family-communication.description: Family or carers and staff share updates about learning and support.

flexible-learning.label: Flexible learning
flexible-learning.description: Where, when or how learning happens is adjusted so the student can take part.

movement-breaks.label: Movement breaks
movement-breaks.description: Planned pauses for movement are part of the routine.
